### Encouragement for Today: Let Your Yes Be Yes
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-05-26-04-1263268.html
Passage: Matthew 5:37
Points:
- People often look for technicalities and loopholes to avoid speaking the full truth.
- Jesus addressed oath-taking to call His followers to simple, consistent integrity in word and deed.
- An honorable life requires doing what we say we will do without offering flimsy excuses.
- Demonstrating reliability in everyday matters builds credibility so our gospel witness rings true.

### Talk is Cheap
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-jan-9-2009-11597927.html
Passage: Matthew 5:37
Points:
- Society frequently normalizes making casual promises without following through on them.
- Believers easily fall into offering quick verbal commitments without serious follow-through.
- Followers of Christ are called to a higher standard of personal honesty and accountability.
- Actions demonstrate true faith far more effectively than empty words.
- Christians should pause and consider their ability to follow through before making commitments.
